RagShortTexts: Dominican inquisitors established systematic registers of interrogations to uproot heresy.

Variants.Content: Papal bulls entrusted inquisitorial authority to the Order of Preachers (Dominicans). Traveling with portable archives, inquisitors recorded secret denunciations into cross-referenced parchment registers. Those convicted of Cathar or Waldensian heresy face forfeiture of estate, perpetual confinement, or secular execution.
The inquest seeks spiritual rehabilitation before damnation. Notaries record every confession under oath; reconciled penitents may escape the stake by donning yellow felt crosses of penance.
When the black friars enter a village, neighbors stop speaking across orchard hedges. One grudge whispered to an informer, and a man finds himself in church cellars before sunset.
